caseStudies.subtitle: CASE STUDY 01
caseStudies.title: Scaling PLG → SLG at an AI Video Platform
caseStudies.challenge: A product-led AI company hitting an inflection point needed to build an enterprise GTM from scratch. This involved new personas, a new sales motion, and a new marketing stack, all while maintaining their PLG momentum.
caseStudies.approach: We built the full marketing function from the ground up: messaging architecture, persona frameworks, enterprise sales enablement, pricing strategy, community-led growth, and a RevOps stack connecting over 15 systems.
caseStudies.outcomes: Established a clear path to $20M+ in enterprise revenue. We aligned the organization around Active Seats as a Tier 1 KPI, built a 78K+ member community, and launched an SEO localization program across 15 languages and 5 regions.

caseStudies.subtitle: CASE STUDY 02
caseStudies.title: Competitive Positioning for a DevSecOps Platform
caseStudies.challenge: A developer security platform was competing against incumbents 10 times their size. They needed differentiated positioning, a POV-based sales process, and content that truly resonated with technical buyers.
caseStudies.approach: We built competitive comparison pages with data-driven messaging. This included creating POV templates and success criteria frameworks for enterprise deals, along with battlecards and enablement programs.
caseStudies.outcomes: The comparison pages became top converting assets. We saw POV win rates increase through structured evaluation criteria, while sales confidence improved via a systematic enablement program.

caseStudies.subtitle: CASE STUDY 03
caseStudies.title: Underdog Marketing for an Enterprise Content Platform
caseStudies.challenge: An enterprise content governance platform was competing against household-name cloud storage giants. Facing a 50x brand awareness gap, they needed to win on differentiation rather than budget.
caseStudies.approach: We led the design of product tour experiences, interactive demos, and content that reframed the category around compliance and governance, the area where incumbents were weakest. We also built integrated campaigns spanning SEO, events, and customer advocacy.
caseStudies.outcomes: Product tours became the primary conversion driver. We successfully repositioned the brand from 'file sharing' to 'content governance,' creating a defensible category that earned analyst recognition.
